description: Reverses Head+Tail segment PAIRS in place (submode 3): the marklist datafile cuts the sound into alternating Head/Tail segments (first mark = a Head) and each Head+Tail pair plays backwards in its own slot - structured retrograde editing without an editor. Duration static and SAMPLE-EXACT on every probe (88200 frames preserved: sweep, flat noise, unipolar clicks). The nine submodes reverse different groupings (1 Tails only, 2 Heads only, 3 Head+Tail pairs - this entry, 4-9 progressively larger overlapping sets); submodes differ audibly (1 vs 3 renders differ, verified) and share the same argv - siblings via execute(). Needs at least 4 mark values ('ERROR: Insufficient data (1 values) in file m1.txt : Need at least 4' verbatim). Deterministic, no scalar parameters at all. MONO only.
musical_use: Rhythm-preserving retrograde: because each reversed chunk stays in its slot, the phrase's timing grid survives while its contents run backwards - speech keeps its cadence but the syllables inhale, drums keep the pattern but every hit swells instead of striking. Mark at syllable/beat boundaries (onset detection + write_data_file) for the classic effect; marking off-grid creates lurching, seasick reversals. Submode choice = how much context flips at once: 1-2 for subtle inversions of only tails/heads, 3 for full pairwise retrograde, 5/7/9 for longer wave-like reversals. Zero parameters means renders are entirely determined by the marklist - iterate there.

marklist.description: REQUIRED datafile of times (seconds, one per line) marking alternating Head/Tail boundaries; the first mark is assumed to start a Head. At least 4 values (refusal verbatim). write_data_file(); any extension except .brk.
